verdict.rationale: Elicit documents its own exports in open formats. The Library exports as RIS, tables export as CSV/Excel, some source tables as RIS/BIB, and Research Reports as PDF/Word. However, there is no documented account-wide 'export everything' capability, and Systematic Review table export is limited to Pro, Scale and Enterprise subscribers. Missing for 10: a single full-account export, export of agent sessions/chats, projects, skills and uploaded PDFs, export available on all plans, and independent corroboration that exports are complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Your Elicit Library can be exported as a .ris file, which you can import into Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, or another reference manager.
Tables can be exported in CSV and Excel format. Certain tables of sources can be exported as RIS or BIB files.
Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.
Research Reports can be exported as a PDF or Word file, regardless of which Elicit plan you subscribe to.
